colophon: Thus ends the Durga Kavacha, in the Shri Kubjika Tantra.

lines.2: Of this Durga Kavacha, Ishvara is the seer, anushtubh the meter, Durga the deity; it is used in recitation.
lines.4: Listen, O Goddess, I will tell you the armor that grants every success;
lines.5: reading it, and having it read, a person is freed from danger.
lines.6: O Goddess, whoever chants the Durga mantra without knowing this armor
lines.7: does not gain its fruit, and goes to the worst hell.
lines.8: O Goddess, this most secret armor is told to you:
lines.9: keep it hidden with care, and take it in attentively.
lines.10: Om. May the goddess Uma protect my head; she who bears the trident, my forehead;
lines.11: may Khechari, who moves through the sky, protect my eyes; she who dwells at the crossroads, my ears.
lines.12: May Sugandha, the fragrant, protect my nose; she who sustains all, my face;
lines.13: the goddess Chandika, my tongue; and Saubhadrika, my neck.
lines.14: She who dwells in the ashoka grove, my mind; she who bears the thunderbolt, my two arms;
lines.15: may Mahavani, the great voice, protect my throat; the Mother of the World, my two breasts.
lines.16: The goddess Lalita, my heart; she who rides the lion, my belly;
lines.17: the goddess Bhagavati, my hips; she who dwells in the Vindhyas, my two thighs.
lines.18: Mahabala, the mighty, my two shins; she who dwells on the earth, my feet.
lines.19: So you stand, O Goddess, as the protector of the three worlds:
lines.20: protect me in all my limbs, O Goddess Durga; salutation to you.
lines.21: This is the armor, O Goddess, that grants the fruit of the great knowledge;
lines.22: whoever recites it on rising in the morning gains the merit of a pilgrimage.
lines.23: Whoever places this armor on the body meets no obstacle anywhere;
lines.24: for them there is no fear of bhutas, pretas, or pishachas.
